name: e12-sei
title: E12 · Specific emitter ID (hardware fingerprint) vs retuning
description: Frontline RF on with a high retune rate (operators change link settings between flights, breaking their tracks). SEI reads a hardware fingerprint that survives the settings change, so a retuned track re-links to its parent instead of resetting. Fused payload, everything on, across 40 maps × 3 altitudes.
